Morocco: Area excludes Western Sahara, which Morocco claims and largely controls
W. Sahara: A disputed territory: most of it is controlled by Morocco, which claims it; the Polisario Front's Sahrawi Republic controls the east. Population is approximate
Libya: Divided between rival governments in the west and east since 2014
Sudan: At war since April 2023 between the army and the Rapid Support Forces; figures are very uncertain
